capabilities: Sync IMA personal notes into the vault as Markdown
Download and localize inline images and file attachments
Convert knowledge-base webpages and WeChat articles to Markdown
Run incremental syncs automatically on a configurable interval
Handle IMA-side deletions with delete, keep, or mark modes
disambiguation: Not a two-way sync: content only flows from IMA to Obsidian, and each sync overwrites local files with IMA server content.
extras: Full WeChat article extraction requires the desktop app with 'download enhancement' enabled (headless browser); mobile falls back to text-only meta tag extraction. Subscribed/public knowledge bases are limited to ~300-character note previews and AI summaries of files. The manifest notes the plugin has not been reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to import notes and knowledge-base items stored in Tencent IMA, including WeChat articles, webpages, and file attachments.

relations.evidence: An Obsidian plugin to sync notes from Tencent IMA personal notebook and knowledge base into your Obsidian vault.

requires.name: IMA OpenAPI Client ID and API Key

summary: One-way sync plugin that pulls Tencent IMA personal notes and knowledge-base content into an Obsidian vault as Markdown.
